_comment: secure-vibe scaffolded this starter. Edit ~/.claude-code-router/config.json on the host and re-run. Only the variables referenced by this config are forwarded into the container (resolved from your project .env first, then host env). Model selectors are 'ProviderName/model', so the auto-router below is 'openrouter/openrouter/free' — the first segment is the provider name, the rest is the model id. CCR 3.x ignores Router.default/background — secure-vibe reads them and maps them onto Claude Code's ANTHROPIC_MODEL / ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL, so /model still works at runtime. Default is the free auto-router because individual ':free' models get retired without notice; point Router.default at 'openrouter/qwen/qwen3-coder' (paid, needs credits) for real work.
